decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans Sheet 2, Sheet 4 and Sheet 6 received 28 July 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The conversion of the garage to a habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 42 Burket Close.
description: Removal of the existing garage door and replacement with a window and wall and conversion of the existing garage into bedroom and bathroom for a disabled person
